cover all available pages before exploring further.

# Getting Started

> Start testing your MCP server in minutes

> [!NOTE
]\n>\n> The upcoming SDK 10, CLI 6, and Vitest 0.3 releases require an MCPJam login or `sk_` API key for every eval, including BYO
K runs with uploads disabled. These versions must ship after the backend run-start endpoint is deployed. Earlier versions keep the

ir existing behavior.

## 1. Choose how to open Inspector

Every option below opens the MCPJam Inspector. Pick one based on wh

ere your MCP server runs.

> [card] [Web](https://app.mcpjam.com)
>
> No install. HTTPS servers only. Share servers with your

team.

> [card] [Terminal](https://docs.mcpjam.com/installation.md#terminal)
>
> `npx @mcpjam/inspector@latest`. Requires Node

.js. HTTP/S and local STDIO.

> [card] [macOS](https://docs.mcpjam.com/installation.md#desktop-app)
>
> Desktop app (`.dmg`).

No Node.js. HTTP/S and local STDIO.

> [card] [Windows](https://docs.mcpjam.com/installation.md#desktop-app)
>
> Desktop app (

`.exe` installer). No Node.js. HTTP/S and local STDIO.

> [card] [Docker](https://docs.mcpjam.com/installation.md#docker)
>
>
Pull from Docker Hub. HTTP/S, plus STDIO servers that run inside the container.\n\n* **Your server has a public HTTPS URL**: any o
ption works. The web app needs no install.\n* **Your server runs on `localhost` or over STDIO**: use Terminal or the macOS or Wind
ows desktop app. The web app can't reach it.\n* **You want Inspector isolated in a container**: use Docker. Reach servers on your
machine at `http://host.docker.internal:PORT`, and note that STDIO commands run inside the container, not on your machine.\n\nSee

[Installation](https://docs.mcpjam.com/installation.md#which-one-do-i-need) for the full comparison.

## 2. Connect a server
On first launch, MCPJam shows a **Welcome** overlay that guides you through connecting your first server. You can:\n\n* **Enter yo
ur own server** — paste an HTTPS URL (e.g. `https://your-server.example/mcp`) or a STDIO command (Terminal, Desktop, and Docker on

ly).
* **Try the Excalidraw demo** — a hosted diagramming MCP app, no setup required.

After connecting, MCPJam shows the serve

r name and tool count, then offers an **Open Playground** button that seeds the chat with the prompt:

```
What can this server

do?
```

Press **Send** to explore your server's tools. No API key, ngrok, or ChatGPT/Claude subscription needed.
